items.objective: In `src/candidate.cpp`, investigate parallelizing the independent per-element pricing work and dispatch using the supplied `threads` budget. Explore a low-overhead serial path for small workloads and suitable work partitioning without hardcoding the environment's 40-thread setting or changing global OpenMP controls. Preserve complete output overwrite and correctness for every entry. Compare whole-call timings across the official workload and available `n`/`threads` cases, including parallel overhead, and record failed scheduling or threshold variants.
